description.value: Bonanza Marsh Conservation Area is a Nature Conservancy of Canada-managed nature reserve in the Kootenays region of British Columbia, protecting wetland and marsh habitat. Operated by one of Canada's leading private land conservation organizations, the site represents NCC's ongoing work to safeguard biodiversity in the Columbia Basin. Touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays may find it a scenic natural stop along their route.
